origin_target_policy: Reuse the two post-event synthetic coordinates in the bus case; snap separately to each permitted mode network without selecting by result
restriction_assumption: Only for sensitivity analysis, block each mode-permitted linear edge whose geometry intersects the buffered, unreviewed BCC Pushkin motor-road candidate geometry. The road notice does not attest a walking or cycling closure.
claim_ceiling: Exploratory conditional topology and fixed-speed route sensitivity on current OSM; not race-day nonmotor access, actual detour, observed travel time or prediction accuracy
